limitations: r70 gameplay NOT RUN: the cut picture matching r68's rests on the quad rebuild read in bytes; the edge glyph draws only under Heavy Polish, so `edge=0` without it is expected (r69 run)
a live drag in UIScale's editor has no report
r67 has a player report on MHGURecomp beside KatLib and UIScale, and logs from one plain Eden session
the box model for a rescaled bar has only host fixtures until a `bar drawn` log line shows it agreeing with the game's rect
the fill is accepted by the player's eye on the bar, not by a recorded number: the build logs no fill value, so no run carries a band value
the raised-maximum band ends have no runtime check: no saved log was identified as using a Sharpness skill, so host fixtures and static reading are the evidence
Heavy Polish over the banded bar has no runtime check
the `fill refused` line has never been seen in a run; it may print at a normal quest end, and it means a failure only when the stock bar shows during a hunt
the fill makes about 18 native calls per frame on the draw thread; that thread is one thread by static reading and unconfirmed at runtime
the colour driver's order against adjustSharpness and the draw is unread, so a tier drop could show a full bar in the old colour briefly; the player reports nothing wrong
a gauge row lasting one quest is inference from row ends beside save commits and tester reports: no log line marks an area change
the clip mask's bit 17 is the transform gate in main+0xa4964c / main+0xa4969c; what the shade looks like once the clip is composed rests on accepted r62's red-tier crop

the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block the mod publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and the old 4-word block still leaks, 16 bytes per quest
the coloured part keeps the glow's halo (Txt_sharpefx at PosX 6, PosY -6, 88x32, alpha 120) and the dark part has none: a design question left open
the bar rect other than 110..238: the scaled cut offsets have only been seen where they reproduce the measured numbers
ARM fixtures for insertion and allocation failure are not written
Switch hardware unconfirmed; r67 and earlier can crash Ryubing after insertion, r68 ran three quests there
